decision.rationale: The approved protocol is bounded and technically coherent, but the current setup has no live supported mmWave interface, no verified sensor identity or raw/timestamp/health stream, and no authoritative empty-zone evidence mechanism. These are missing resources and access controls, not a contract contradiction or a data-collection authorization.

findings.current_evidence: No target interface was detected during the preflight.
findings.minimum_resource: A physically available supported sensor assigned to the campaign.

findings.current_evidence: Repository capture tooling exists, but no live target interface or raw stream was verified.
findings.minimum_resource: Approved host-to-sensor interface, permissions, and a non-campaign connectivity check.

findings.current_evidence: No live device was available for interrogation.
findings.minimum_resource: Device serial/identifier, firmware version, configuration identity or hash, and interface settings recorded from the live device.

findings.current_evidence: Neither field family was observed from a live stream.
findings.minimum_resource: Live telemetry that exposes timestamp, continuity, fault/dropout, and health/configuration fields required by the contract.

hardware_feasibility.conclusion: The hardware path is plausible but not presently executable. Hardware readiness may be established only by resource access and a separate non-campaign verification.

findings.minimum_resource: An authorized continuous occupancy reference covering the full target zone, independently reviewable and time synchronized.
A sealed-zone/access record that covers the recording and proves no human, animal, respiration simulator, or other physiological source is present.
A shared host clock or explicit synchronization marker, with recorded alignment evidence; visual guess alignment is not acceptable.
Tamper-evident hashes for the occupancy/access evidence and an immediate post-capture SHA-256 receipt binding each actual recording to its predeclared identity.

evidence_feasibility.conclusion: Authoritative ABSENT proof is feasible only if an independent occupancy and access-control mechanism is supplied. It cannot be inferred from radar non-detection, weak periodicity, or an operator assertion alone.

hardware: one designated supported mmWave sensor with stable power and a supported recording interface
one authorized occupancy-reference system that continuously covers the fixed target zone
rigid mount and measured target-zone geometry
a host capable of retaining immutable raw recordings and timestamps
personnel: sensor custodian able to identify firmware and configuration
capture operator responsible for the fixed nine-slot protocol
independent evidence reviewer for occupancy/access and negative-class evidence
environment: controlled indoor room with a bounded target zone and controlled access
static non-human background with no animal, physiological source, periodic moving reflector, fan, or respiration simulator
ability to maintain a continuous 300-second empty interval per fixed slot
software_and_evidence_tooling: non-campaign interface checker for raw fields, monotonic timestamps, continuity, and health telemetry
campaign artifact generator that can create the pre-capture identity lock and immediate one-to-one SHA-256 receipts
time-synchronization evidence recorder and immutable occupancy/access evidence hasher
recording, occupancy/evidence, sensor-health, and rejection registries

preconditions_before_any_campaign_predec: All hardware and evidence resources in the minimum resource package are physically available and verified.
A non-campaign interface and evidence-tooling check passes without creating campaign evidence.
The authoritative occupancy reference, access-control procedure, target-zone geometry, and synchronization method are approved.
All nine slot identities can be completely declared before the first capture.
preserved_rules: ABSENT remains no-human-target, no-target-physiological-source, valid-sensor, intended-negative evidence only.
The three lineage groups, fixed nine slots, checksum lifecycle, no-replacement rule, and deterministic CHRONOLOGICAL_FIRST_N_QUALIFYING_V1 rule are unchanged.
No capture, membership construction, evaluation, candidate-output access, or M-PV4 authorization follows from this audit.
